card.title: IPad 9 No Backlight (LCD Problem)

claims.statement: The iPad 9 LCD has a known defect where its backlight cable tears inside the panel; it can be repaired by cutting a small access hole, scraping to expose the copper traces and jumpering them.
Use minimal flux—it can seep into the LCD and stain it.

procedure: Remove the sticker and metal plate.
Cut a small hole with a precision dremel (slowly, shallow).
Scrape to expose traces; jumper the break.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Cutting too deep damages the LCD; excess flux stains it.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
